parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.

parameters.name: SupplierRole
parameters.description: The role of the service provider.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-usages --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU= --filter '[{"Value":["5"],"Name":"ServiceId"}]' --supplier-role Supplier --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier ListServiceUsages --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU=' --Filter.1.Value.1 5 --SupplierRole Supplier --MaxResults 20 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Name ServiceId
